verdict.line: You lose if you let Sion farm Enrage autos and E-charge Qs into you for free; you win if you dodge the Q read with E and punish his no-mana all-in windows.

brief.thesis: Sion has no sustained mana cost on E (Enrage), so he can turn on bonus AD at will and trade autos, but his all-in hinges on landing Q (Cryptic Gaze, 12/11/10/9/8s cooldown) to lock you down first. Jax's E (Counter Strike, 18/16/14/12/10s cooldown) dodges all basic attacks and stuns on release, so timing it to eat the Q read or the Enrage trade window is the entire lane. At 45.6% over 114 games this is genuinely close — it swings on who flinches first in the stare-down.

theirWindow.when: Sion channels Q stare at you
theirWindow.what: If you're caught at range with Q up and no escape, you get stunned and eat a full Enrage trade. Walk behind minions or break line of sight the instant you see the channel start.

yourWindow.when: Sion's Q is on cooldown, he's mid-channel, or he over-extends on Enrage autos
yourWindow.what: This is when you Q (Leap Strike) in, pop W (Empower) on the engage hit, and threaten E (Counter Strike) the moment he commits to autos — the stun locks him down and your passive bonus Health from AD/AP items makes these trades favor you.

boots.why: 50.4% pick rate and the better winrate (43.5% over 62 games) — the reduced basic-attack damage directly undercuts Sion's auto-attack-based Enrage pressure.

runes.keystoneWhy: Run in the higher-pick page (24.1% pick, 52.9% winrate) — the ramping attack speed rewards extended trades once you've dodged his Q with E, since he can't out-sustain a prolonged attack-speed duel.

summoners.why: The highest-winrate combo at 48.1% over a 56.4% pick rate — Ignite punishes Sion's Health-stacking Enrage trades and secures early skirmishes before he snowballs max HP from kills.

playing.title: Bait the Q, don't eat it
playing.detail: Stay at the edge of Sion's 550 range and watch for the stare channel. If he commits Q at you with no minion to block it, save E (Counter Strike) to dodge the follow-up autos rather than burning it preemptively.

playing.title: Punish post-Q cooldown
playing.detail: The instant Cryptic Gaze goes on cooldown (8-12s depending on rank), Q (Leap Strike) in and W (Empower) the engage hit — he has no stun to answer with.

playing.title: Time E around Enrage autos
playing.detail: Enrage has no cooldown, so Sion can turn it on the moment he decides to trade. When you see him start stacking AD-for-Health autos, pop Counter Strike to dodge them and stun him on release.

playing.title: Don't facecheck his shield
playing.detail: W (Death's Caress) absorbs damage and explodes in an area if left up — don't walk into melee range while it's active, or back off and let it detonate on nothing.

playing.title: Freeze past level 6 ults
playing.detail: Both R's are low-cooldown (yours is 0s, his is 90s) — after level 6, play slightly safer when his Cannibalism is up since he heals off every attack during it.

playing.title: Snowball with Trinity spike
playing.detail: Once Trinity Force completes, your trades swing hard in your favor — look to force fights near that power spike rather than passively farming.

playing.title: Track his max-HP growth
playing.detail: Enrage permanently grows his max Health on takedowns, so prioritize denying him kills/assists on minions under tower or in skirmishes to slow his scaling.

brief.patchCaveat: Build paths, runes, summoners, and the 45.6% head-to-head winrate over 114 games are measured from current-patch OP.GG data; the ability timing calls and trade windows are my own tactical read on top of that data.

stats.opponentTip: Avoid being Sion’s fully charged Decimating Smash (Q)! Use Counter Strike [E] to interrupt Decimating Smash (Q).
